actions.action: Soak soil thoroughly until water drains, then empty saucer
If soil is hydrophobic, bottom-water in a tray for 20-30 minutes
Move plant to bright, indirect light indoors
If going outside again, acclimate gradually with gentle morning light
Let soil dry almost completely before watering again (every 2-3 weeks)
Amend soil with perlite/pumice or repot into cactus/succulent mix
Ensure pot has a drainage hole
Monitor center for firm new growth
If base is mushy/black, stop watering and check roots
If plant is loose, unpot, trim dead roots and repot into dry gritty mix
Provide brighter indoor spot or small grow light long-term

reason: The answer identifies underwatering plus sun stress from going outdoors, matching the reference, and its main advice (water thoroughly, bring him back to indirect light indoors) matches the fix; nothing in it is harmful.
